practiceReport.name: Dee Winters
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (LB) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Missed prior game without practice participation — awaiting Wednesday report
practiceReport.beatComment: Winters has hurt in the second quarter and had to be helped off the field by trainers. He was initially deemed questionable to return before being ruled out in the second half. Winters will finish the game with two tackles (both solo). The Cowboys next play on Thanksgiving against Philadelphia, and it's unclear if Winters will be able to suit up for that contest.

practiceReport.name: Jalen Thompson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (8th NFL season, 81% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: 21-day IR window open (Week 2); logged Full Participation in prior week's ramp
Starter / core rotational role increases 53-man roster activation priority (+3%)
Requires formal 53-man roster activation prior to weekly NFL transaction deadline
practiceReport.beatComment: Thompson was a full participant in practice both Thursday and Friday, but the veteran safety is not quite ready to be activated from injured reserve. He'll end up missing an eighth consecutive game due to a hamstring injury he picked up in Week 3 against the Ravens. Thompson's next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Eagles on Thanksgiving Day.

practiceReport.name: Otito Ogbonnia
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Ogbonnia suffered a finger injury in the second quarter and was subsequently deemed questionable to return. However, he was able to get back on the field after halftime. Ogbonnia will thus continue to play a key role along Dallas' defensive line.

practiceReport.name: Donovan Ezeiruaku
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (LB) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Ezeiruaku didn't play against the 49ers in Week 10 due to an ankle injury. He's avoided an injury tag for Week 11 after logging a full practice Friday, and his return means less rotational snaps at the edge rusher position will be available for James Houston and Von Miller. Ezeiruaku has 32 tackles (16 solo), including 2.5 sacks, and one forced fumble across nine regular-season games.

practiceReport.name: Luke Schoonmaker
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: Schoonmaker was unable to practice Thursday or Friday because he was under the weather, but the tight end appears to be feeling well enough to suit up Sunday. Meanwhile, Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) will miss his second straight game, opening the door for Schoonmaker to potentially log a larger workload than usual on offense. With Ferguson out last Sunday versus San Francisco, Schoonmaker posted a season-high 35 percent offensive snap share and caught one of two targets for 12 yards.

irAndReserveTracker.name: DaRon Bland
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 14 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Bland was expected to miss multiple games due to an ankle injury that he sustained in Week 10 against the 49ers. His placement on IR means he's required to miss at least four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 16 against the Jaguars on Sunday, Dec. 27. Ameer Speed and Cobie Durant are both in line for larger roles in Dallas' secondary in Bland's absence.
